title: AIDetox Scholarly Documentation Style Contract
description: Deterministic documentation writing standards and stylistic invariants frozen from the AIDetox research kernel for multilingual scholarly repositories.

authoring_principles: Identity of speaker is explicit; facts have verifiable sources.
Expressions provide genuine informational increment, not formulaic filler.
Contradictions and negative findings are preserved rather than smoothed over.
No fabricated operational details or unevidenced certainty.
Style fixes must never alter numbers, negations, comparisons, code, or links.
Qualitative assessments report concrete discrete features and counts rather than subjective composite scores.

user_facing_documentation.rules: Task-oriented, natural academic register, devoid of engineering jargon and formulaic step broadcasting.

technical_and_schema_specifications.rules: Clarity prioritized; precise technical terminology and schema constraints preserved verbatim.

research_plans_and_evaluations.rules: Eliminate synthetic hype phrases; preserve dialectical argumentation and epistemic uncertainty.

historical_and_audit_records.rules: Preserve historical terms and verbatim quotes; restrict edits to grammatical clarity without rewriting factual history.
